answer: One control decides whether a farm gets in, and it is Weaver cloth standard lodged with the weavers guild — 1-year apprenticeship, 268 supervised cloths, guild exam, 77 POA annual fee, renewal. Faking at scale is a payroll: 479 aliases, each demanding 119 POA and 13 minutes, a standing bill of 57001 POA. A real delta has a date on it, a real nadir has a receipt behind it, and a real grove has a witness beside it. The epoch rewards the agent who paid once, not the farm that paid never.
